system.name: System
system.description: Tricordarr-specific events such as server connection issues and alerts.

content.name: Content
content.description: Content that comes from Twitarr itself such as Seamails or Twarrts.

seamail.name: Seamail
seamail.description: Seamail content from the Twitarr server.

lfg.name: LFG
lfg.description: LFG content from the Twitarr server.

forums.name: Forums
forums.description: Forum content from the Twitarr server.

events.name: Events
events.description: Event content from the Twitarr server.

phoneCallAnswered.title: Call Answered
phoneCallAnswered.doc: The callee answered the call, possibly on another device.

alertwordTwarrt.title: Twarrt Alert Words
alertwordTwarrt.doc: A user has posted a Twarrt that contains a word this user has set as an alertword.

twarrtMention.title: Twarrt Mention
twarrtMention.doc: A user has posted a Twarrt that @mentions this user.

microKaraokeSongReady.title: MicroKaraoke Song Ready
microKaraokeSongReady.doc: A Micro Karaoke song the user contributed to is ready for viewing. .

seamailUnreadMsg.title: New Seamail
seamailUnreadMsg.doc: A participant in a Seamail thread the user is a member of has posted a new message.

fezUnreadMsg.title: New LFG Message
fezUnreadMsg.doc: A participant in a Chat the user is a member of has posted a new message.

privateEventUnreadMsg.title: New Private Event Message
privateEventUnreadMsg.doc: An invitee to a Private Event has posted a new chat message in the event's chat.

announcement.title: Announcement
announcement.doc: A server-wide announcement has just been added.

alertwordPost.title: Forum Alert Word
alertwordPost.doc: A user has posted a Forum Post that contains a word this user has set as an alertword.

forumMention.title: Forum Mention
forumMention.doc: A user has posted a Forum Post that @mentions this user.

twitarrTeamForumMention.title: TwitarrTeam Forum Mention
twitarrTeamForumMention.doc: A new or edited forum post that now @mentions @twitarrteam.

moderatorForumMention.title: Moderator Forum Mention
moderatorForumMention.doc: A new or edited forum post that now @mentions @moderator.

incomingPhoneCall.title: Incoming Call
incomingPhoneCall.doc: Someone is trying to call this user via KrakenTalk.'

phoneCallEnded.title: Call Ended
phoneCallEnded.doc: Caller hung up while phone was rining, or other party ended the call in progress, or callee declined

followedEventStarting.title: Followed Event Starting
followedEventStarting.doc: An event the user is following is about to start.

joinedLFGStarting.title: Joined LFG Starting
joinedLFGStarting.doc: An LFG the user has joined is about to start.

personalEventStarting.title: Private Event Starting
personalEventStarting.doc: A Personal Event the user has created or was added to is about to start.

addedToPrivateEvent.title: Added to Private Event
addedToPrivateEvent.doc: The creator of the event has added this user.

addedToLFG.title: Added to LFG
addedToLFG.doc: The creator of the LFG has added this user.

addedToSeamail.title: Added to Seamail
addedToSeamail.doc: Only for 'open' seamails. The owner of the chata has added this user.
addedToSeamail.note:
Added to Chat - only fires when someone else adds you to their chat.
Note: I'm specifically not making notifications for "Removed From Chat" because: it can feel mean to receive that notification, and there's nowhere for the notification to take the user.

privateEventCanceled.title: Private Event Canceled
privateEventCanceled.doc: A Private Event the user has joined has been canceled.

lfgCanceled.title: LFG Canceled
lfgCanceled.doc: An LFG the user has joined has been canceled.
